description: Parse and normalize an Argentine phone number written in any local style (011 15 1234-5678, +54 9 11..., 0351 4..., 15 prefix): strips trunk 0 and mobile 15, returns the 10-digit national number, E.164 in landline (+54) and mobile (+549) forms, a wa.me WhatsApp link and whether it is a mobile. Offline, nothing is stored. Send {phone}. Paid tool: 0.01 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana, no account or key). An unpaid call returns a payment-required result (isError, structuredContent with x402Version 2 and accepts); sign one of the accepts and retry the same call with the PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Returns JSON text; the settlement is in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].

phone.description: Argentine phone number in any common format

name: ar_phone
title: Normalize Argentine phone
